$comment: [[D-PP-INCOMPATIBLE-REDEFINITION-IS-FATAL]] and [[D-PP-REDEFINITION-IGNORES-WHITESPACE-PRESENCE]] closed 2026-08-18 — the runnable witness that DSS resolves an incompatible macro redefinition the way the compilers it declares itself to be do. ★★★ THE DEFECT WAS BIDIRECTIONAL, WHICH IS WHY ONE FIXTURE CLOSES TWO ROWS. DSS was STRICTER than every reference on the five shapes `sameDefinition` can report (fatal `P0014` where they warn at rc=0) and simultaneously LAXER on a sixth (SILENT where they warn), because `MacroDef::text` joined replacement tokens with one space unconditionally and so read `40+2` and `40 + 2` as one definition. The standing rule is that reference compilers are the spec BIDIRECTIONALLY — never reject what they accept, never silently accept what they diagnose — and only a per-shape sweep could see both halves. ✔MEASURED, one TU per shape, `x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc -std=c2x -pedantic` cross-checked with MSVC `cl /Zs`: parameter spelling, replacement text, arity, object-vs-function-like, and variadic-vs-not ALL warn at rc=0, none is fatal, and in EVERY case the SECOND definition is the one in effect at runtime; only `-Werror` stops a build, which is a choice about warnings rather than a property of the construct. ★★ THE VALUE HALF IS THE ONE THAT COULD HAVE SILENTLY MISCOMPILED, and it is why this is a RUN witness rather than a compile-only one: the old code both errored AND retained the OLD definition, so a severity-only change would have left DSS agreeing about the diagnostic and disagreeing about the PROGRAM — strictly worse than failing loud. Every arm here is an arithmetic contribution to the exit code (2 + 20 + 4 + 10 + 2 + 4 = 42), so any redefinition resolving to the first definition moves it. ★ THE ARITY ARM IS THE STRONGEST because it cannot degrade quietly: the second definition takes two parameters, so a regression to the first makes the call ill-formed rather than merely wrong. ★ THE LIVE CONSUMER: sqlite's `shell.c.in` defines `S_ISLNK(mode) (0)` at line 141, BEFORE its `#include <sys/stat.h>` at line 148, so the shipped `sys/stat.json` macro splices on top of it — fatal on DSS, fine on gcc/clang/MSVC. ⚠ Matching a descriptor's parameter SPELLING to whichever consumer is in front of us today was the alternative, and it is a lottery on the next consumer, not a fix. ⚠ `seed` is `volatile` on purpose: without it the optimizer folds every macro use to a literal and the release arm stops exercising the preprocessor at all — it would pass on a compiler that resolved the redefinitions wrongly. ⛔ THE WHITESPACE-*AMOUNT* PAIR IS DELIBERATELY NOT HERE: `4 + 38` vs `4  +  38` is IDENTICAL under C 6.10.3p2 (amount is immaterial, presence is not) and must stay SILENT, but 'no diagnostic' is not observable from an exit code — it is pinned in test_preprocessor.cpp instead, alongside the comment-is-whitespace case. ★ RED-ON-DISABLE, all three halves, each verified by the subject BINARY's mtime and run through ctest (never a bare exe): restore `DiagnosticSeverity::Error` and the severity pin fails; re-add the early `return` after the diagnostic and the value pins fail (`which is: "1"` against `"2"`); drop the `a.spacing == b.spacing` term from `sameDefinition` and the whitespace pin fails.
